name: gravewounds-maps
description: Builds data/maps.json (conflict locator maps) from Natural Earth coastlines, borders and lakes (npm ci && node make_maps.mjs), and the campaign maps and battlefields (node make_agincourt.mjs, make_agincourt_field.mjs, make_towton.mjs, make_towton_field.mjs, make_visby.mjs, make_visby_field.mjs).
